'''Taris survival gloves''' were a type of utilitarian [[Glove/Legends|glove]] produced by a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning corporation known as [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] soon after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] was [[Destruction of Taris|bombarded]] by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]], at the order of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]] in [[3956 BBY]]. The gloves were named after Taris in order to market the gloves' defensive protection, and were still in use by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]].

==Description==
A type of all-purpose [[Glove/Legends|glove]], the [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] survival gloves were designed to provide their users with additional protection. The outsides of the gloves were a [[Color/Legends|light-tan]] color, while the insides were brown in color.<ref name="kotor2" />

==History==
Taris survival gloves were created by the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning corporation known as [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] shortly after the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Taris was [[Destruction of Taris|bombarded]] by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]], during the [[Jedi Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire<ref name="kotor2" /> in [[3956 BBY]].<ref name="kotorcg" /> Czerka named the gloves after Taris in order to prompt buyers into viewing the gloves' defensive properties as a good idea.<ref name="kotor2" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3951 BBY]], during a series of conflicts between the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire and the Galactic Republic known as the [[Dark Wars]],<ref name="kotorcg" /> the gloves were well-liked and quite common, selling for prices around 150 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="kotor2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Taris survival gloves first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', a [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[Obsidian Entertainment]]. In ''The Sith Lords'', the gloves were a common item that could be found in randomly determined locations throughout the game, and because of this, it was not guaranteed to appear each time through the game. The gloves granted the player with a small bonus to all saves, which allowed the player to resist certain attacks. The gloves' description referenced the bombardment of Taris,<ref name="kotor2" /> which occurred during ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', the previous game in the series.<ref name="kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> The Taris survival gloves also received an entry in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide]]'' by [[Prima Games]].<ref name="kotorguide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
